verdict.rationale: Teams has a public developer documentation platform, so the question of whether that documentation is agent-consumable applies. Probes found no llms.txt (HTTP 404) and no Markdown docs variant (HTTP 404). The docs about building agents for Teams describe developing agents, not documentation formatted for agents to read, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
